title: Polynomial-time packing of function values
statement: Let $\mathrm{fs}$ be a finite list of functions from binary words to binary words, and suppose every function in the list is polynomial-time computable. Then the function sending an input $x$ to the packed encoding of the list of values of those functions at $x$, in list order, is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{fs}$ is a finite list of functions from binary words to binary words
every function in $\mathrm{fs}$ is polynomial-time computable
replaced: If every function in a finite list of string functions is polynomial-time computable, then so is the function sending an input $x$ to the packed self-delimiting encoding of the list of their values at $x$; all repeated input scans are charged by composition.
